## Academic profile

Professor of Biochemistry and Cancer Sciences at Université Grenoble Alpes and senior medical biochemist at Grenoble Alpes University Hospital.

My work develops translational approaches at the interface of laboratory medicine, cancer biology, environmental health and elemental imaging, with a particular focus on laser-induced breakdown spectroscopy (LIBS) applied to biological tissues.

## Research focus

### Elemental pathology and BioLIBS

Development of tissue elemental imaging approaches to visualize, localize and quantify endogenous and exogenous elements in human tissues, with applications to environmental and occupational exposure, lung disease, cancer and biomaterials.

### Metals and health

Study of the biological and medical implications of metals, particles and elemental signatures in human disease, from exposure assessment to clinical translation.

### Cancer sciences

Research in tumor biology, theranostics and translational oncology, including the development of innovative analytical and imaging approaches.

## Current scientific environment

My activities are based at Université Grenoble Alpes, Grenoble Alpes University Hospital and the Institute for Advanced Biosciences (Inserm U1209 / CNRS UMR 5309 / UGA).
